DEVELOPMENT DATA ONLY: this file lives under backend/prisma/ alongside the
seed, is never written to the database, and is never served to a browser.
It must not be moved under frontend/public/.
prompt through an image-generation provider and writes the optimised WebP
House rules for every prompt: photographic, not illustrated; realistic human
proportions; a Kenyan setting where the event has one; and no logos, no
watermarks and no text, so the artwork never fakes a sponsor, a brand or an
endorsement, and never duplicates the card's live title/date/price UI.
